user.title: Connect your Hilo account
user.description: Sign in with the same email and password you use in the Hilo app. Blood pressure is computed in Aktiia's cloud, so this account is where the measurements come from.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: Your Hilo session for {username} expired. Enter the password again to reconnect.

error.invalid_auth: Aktiia rejected that email or password.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Aktiia cloud. Check your internet connection and try again.

abort.already_configured: This Hilo account is already set up.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll the Aktiia cloud. The band only syncs a few times a day, so short intervals do not give fresher data.
data_description.enable_ble: Also listen for the band's Bluetooth advertisements to tell whether it is nearby. Passive only - it never connects, so it cannot disturb the Hilo app on your phone.
